maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from advertising, media, PR and marketing services for brands, not repair, maintenance or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are private brands and corporations paying for advertising, media, PR and marketing services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through agency networks and client wins; the large Interpublic merger was a one-off, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Agency services like advertising, media buying and PR can be re-tendered; clients switch agencies with moderate friction, not regulatory or technical lock-in.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgement call; agency switching has some cost via data and platform integration (Omni, Acxiom).
